dtldesc: A Modern High-Rise Living Experience in the Heart of Malad East, MumbaiPositioned within the vibrant suburb of Malad East, this contemporary 2 BHK apartment in DEM Phoenix offers an ideal blend of urban convenience and comfortable living. Set in a newly constructed development by DEM Infra, the property is thoughtfully designed for modern lifestyles, making it suitable for both end-users and investors. With its elevated floor position, excellent connectivity, and ready-to-move-in status, this residence provides a compelling opportunity to own a home in one of Mumbais well-connected residential corridors.Property SpecificationsThis well-planned apartment features a super built-up area of 520 sq. ft and is located on the 17th floor of a 23-storey tower, offering expansive views of the surrounding cityscape along with garden and road-facing aspects. The flat comprises two bedrooms and two bathrooms, designed efficiently to maximise available space. Its north-facing orientation ensures favourable natural light and ventilation. The apartment is currently unfurnished, allowing buyers complete flexibility to design interiors according to their personal taste and requirements. Being a newly constructed and ready-to-move-in property, it reflects contemporary construction standards and comes with freehold ownership, adding long-term value and security.FacilitiesResidents benefit from a range of essential and lifestyle amenities that enhance everyday living. The building is equipped with two lifts for convenient access across floors and offers one covered parking space. Continuous water supply and minimal power interruptions ensure a hassle-free living experience. The development includes features such as power backup, security systems, intercom facility, visitor parking, and service or goods lift. Recreational amenities such as a childrens play area and kids club make it particularly appealing for families. Additionally, rooftop amenities add to the lifestyle quotient, offering spaces for relaxation and social interaction within the complex.LocalityStrategically located near the Times of India office in Malad East, the property enjoys excellent connectivity to major highways, metro lines, and railway stations, making daily commuting convenient. Malad East is a well-developed suburb known for its mix of residential and commercial infrastructure, providing easy access to schools, healthcare centres, shopping malls, and entertainment hubs. The neighbourhood continues to grow as a preferred residential destination due to its accessibility and urban conveniences, while still offering pockets of residential calm.This apartment stands out as a practical and future-ready home, combining location advantages, modern amenities, and the flexibility of a newly constructed space in one of Mumbais dynamic localities.

plgdtldesc: Experience elevated urban living with this well-positioned 2 BHK apartment in Runwal Bliss, located in CGS Colony, Kanjurmarg East, Mumbai. Offering a carpet area of 670 sq. ft, this ready-to-move-in residence is situated on the 20th floor of a modern 50-storey tower, providing impressive views of Airoli Creek and the surrounding skyline. Developed by Runwal Enterprises, the project is relatively new with an age of less than 5 years, ensuring contemporary construction quality and design. This semi-furnished resale property is ideal for homebuyers seeking a premium lifestyle in a well-connected and rapidly developing locality.Property SpecificationsThe apartment features two bedrooms, both currently unfurnished, allowing buyers the flexibility to design interiors as per their preferences. The flooring is finished with elegant wooden textures, with variation in the master bedroom adding a distinct touch. The flat includes two bathrooms, one attached to the master bedroom and one common, both equipped with western-style fittings, geysers, and necessary fixtures. The living space is well-planned with access to a balcony that overlooks the scenic Airoli Creek, ensuring ample natural light and ventilation. The kitchen is functional and supported by a piped gas connection, though it does not include a modular setup or chimney. Electrical fittings such as lights and fans are already installed.FacilitiesRunwal Bliss offers a host of modern amenities and essential facilities to enhance everyday living. Residents benefit from 100 percent power backup, round-the-clock water supply, and robust security with CCTV surveillance and guards. The apartment comes with a covered parking space for added convenience. The society includes lifestyle features such as a clubhouse, swimming pool, kids play area, and dedicated childrens water play zones, creating a family-friendly environment. High-speed lifts and well-maintained common areas further contribute to a comfortable residential experience.LocalityKanjurmarg East is a well-connected suburb in Mumbai known for its growing infrastructure and accessibility. The property enjoys proximity to reputed educational institutions such as St. Xavier High School and Junior College, IES Bhandup Primary English School, and Kendriya Vidyalaya IIT Powai. Kanjurmarg Railway Station is nearby, ensuring seamless connectivity across Mumbai, along with access to metro and bus services. The locality also offers easy reach to daily conveniences including markets, healthcare facilities, and shopping destinations, making it an ideal choice for modern urban living.
